## Open

### T-780 — The reader resumes from a token it has already seen

> _2026-11-24 · core/blong-mle · open_

Planned in [#307](https://github.com/feasibleone/blong/issues/307).

`streamRead.ts` and the browser call in `core/blong-gogo/src/adapter/browser/http.ts` accept a
resume token and hand it to the route as `after`; the client that reconnects calls the route again
with the last token it yielded. Nothing about the frame changes: the token is the route's field, and
the reader only carries it across a reconnect.

- verify: a unit test in `core/blong-mle` reads two streams from one reader and asserts the token
  the second call carries.
